## TL;DR
The default `github copilot` model (`default` / `copilot-auto-efficiency`) now maps to the Auto `balance` tier, which exists today, and Copilot tier rejections are turned into plain-English guidance on every failure path. This round fixes review pass 5.

## Work and rationale
- `src/server/freeform-runs.ts`: `oneShotResultFromLog` gained `cli` as a 6th argument after `commandName`, and the freeform caller had been changed to pass the literal `"agent"`, so freeform failures read `agent exited with code N`. It now passes `record.agent.cli` as `commandName` (restoring main's wording, `github copilot exited with code N`) and as the enrichment argument. The test that pinned the new wording is restored to main's expectation while still asserting the tier guidance.
- Earlier rounds on the branch: tier mapping, legacy id alias, enrichment for one-shot, review, engineer banner, agent test and the engineer activity line (stderr enriched before composing; comma and "or" separators; never suggest the failed tier), docs.
- Out of scope, stated explicitly: `probeError` in `src/core/models.ts` and the latent raw `providerFailureDetail` consumers stay as is; `isProviderFailureReason` does not match the tier text today.

## Approaches tried
Passing the same CLI name to both the wording and the enrichment parameter, instead of adding a third parameter.

## Challenges and blockers
Not verified live: running with `--auto-tier balance` spends Copilot credits and no probe was run.

## Key learnings
When a parameter is inserted into a positional list, audit every caller; changing existing error wording must be called out.
